notFormalized.instead: **Formalized since the first edition of this page** (V10.67), as a statement that does not hold as we read it: the strong bundle of Remark 10.5.5 has the local regularity property, and $[\mathrm{Inv}] \neq [1_W]$ with the same orbit map. A version for effective strong bundles is not formalized (Findings, Chapter 10, item 58).

notFormalized.title: Proposition 11.1.6, faces as ep-groupoids, the intersection clause and $[d]_F$
notFormalized.label: §11.1, Proposition 11.1.6, pp. 524–525 (2017: Proposition 11.2, p. 378)
notFormalized.book: For tame face structured $X$: the object and morphism sets of a face are sub-M-polyfolds with tame induced structures and the face is a tame face structured ep-groupoid; two faces meet in a face of each; a generalized isomorphism induces generalized isomorphisms $[d]_F : F \to [d]_*F$ (11.1).
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: it needs the restriction of an ep-groupoid to a closed saturated sub-M-polyfold and the faces $X_\theta$ as unions of faces of the object M-polyfold. The bijection $[d]_*$ and the homeomorphisms $\theta \to [d]_*\theta$ are V11.6; whether the intersection clause holds in the generality stated is left open (Findings, Chapter 11, item 6, 8).

notFormalized.title: §11.2, sc-differential forms up to equivalence
notFormalized.label: §11.2, Theorem 11.2.1 to Proposition 11.2.9, pp. 526–535 (2017: Theorem 11.2 to Proposition 11.5, pp. 380–389)
notFormalized.book: The pull-back of sc-differential forms along generalized maps and the push-forward along generalized isomorphisms, commuting with $d$, independent of choices and, under the local regularity property, determined by the orbit maps.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: sc-differential forms on ep-groupoids are not in the project (G.74, G.80) (V11.9–V11.13; Findings, Chapter 11, item 20).

notFormalized.title: Theorem 11.3.9, the boundary operations of Definition 9.3.8 along equivalences
notFormalized.label: §11.3, Theorem 11.3.9, p. 542 (2017: Theorem 11.7, p. 395)
notFormalized.book: The boundary orientation $\hat T_{\partial\Theta}$ of Definition 9.3.10 is carried by generalized isomorphisms: $\partial(f_*\hat\Theta) = f_*(\partial\hat\Theta)$, independently of the representative.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: that the boundary operations of Definition 9.3.8 satisfy `IsBoundaryTransfer` along equivalences, which needs sc-diffeomorphisms between different M-polyfolds to preserve tame induced structures, $d_M$ and outward vectors; Chapter 9 takes the boundary operation as data (the partial cones of submanifolds are not formalized). Theorem 11.3.9 is proved for a representative under that hypothesis (V11.25; Findings, Chapter 11, item 45).

notFormalized.title: §11.4, integration up to equivalence
notFormalized.label: §11.4, Theorems 11.4.1, 11.4.2, 11.4.4, 11.4.5 and Remark 11.4.3, pp. 542–546 (2017: Theorems 11.8, 11.9, Remark 11.3, pp. 396–399)
notFormalized.book: Generalized isomorphisms transform the canonical measures and the canonical boundary measures (and their effective versions) of oriented compact branched ep⁺-subgroupoids by $|f|$.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: it needs forms (G.74, G.80), branched integration (G.107) and the boundary measures (G.108, G.109), and the orientations of §11.3 (V11.27–V11.29; Findings, Chapter 11, item 50).

notFormalized.title: Proposition 11.5.1, conditions (1) and (2) of Definition 8.3.5
notFormalized.label: §11.5, Proposition 11.5.1, p. 547 (2017: Proposition 11.6, p. 399)
notFormalized.book: $[D]^*N'$ and $[D]_*N$ of auxiliary norms are auxiliary norms.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized** for conditions (1) and (2): they need the level-1 fibre maps of $\mu$ and of a strong bundle equivalence as linear bijections and the level-1 local homeomorphism property near the zero section. Well-definedness, continuity, condition (3), the inverse laws and the dependence on $|[D]|$ only are V11.30 (Findings, Chapter 11, item 60).

notFormalized.title: Lemma 11.5.2 and Proposition 11.5.3, the local section structures of sc⁺-multisections
notFormalized.label: §11.5, Lemma 11.5.2 and Proposition 11.5.3, pp. 547–549 (2017: Lemma 11.7, Proposition 11.7, pp. 400–401)
notFormalized.book: Push-forwards and pull-backs of sc⁺-multisections are sc⁺-multisections: their local section structures are carried along.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: the local section structures (2021 Definition 13.2.1) are not in the project; their transport needs a strong bundle form of Proposition 10.1.9's transport. The underlying functors are V11.31, V11.32 (Findings, Chapter 11, item 61).

notFormalized.title: the localization $\mathcal{PC}(E^{-1})$ and $I : \mathcal{PC} \to \mathcal{PC}(E^{-1})$
notFormalized.label: §11.6, after Proposition 11.6.8, pp. 561–563 (2017 pp. 410–412)
notFormalized.book: Classes of diagrams under common refinement form the morphisms of a category $\mathcal{PC}(E^{-1})$, with composition through weak fibred products, and $I : \mathcal{PC} \to \mathcal{PC}(E^{-1})$ maps equivalences to isomorphisms; the well-definedness of the composition is left to the reader.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**: the equivalence relation on diagrams is V11.41; the category and $I$ are not built (Findings, Chapter 11, item 76).

notFormalized.title: Remark 11.6.9, the category of proper strong bundle coverings
notFormalized.label: §11.6, Remark 11.6.9, pp. 563–566 (2017: Remark 11.4, pp. 412–413)
notFormalized.book: Proper strong bundle coverings, their functors and equivalences, the analogue of Theorem 11.6.6 and the localization, the details left to the reader.
notFormalized.instead: **Not formalized**; Definition 8.5.9 is Chapter 8's `IsProperStrongBundleCovering2021` (V11.42; Findings, Chapter 11, item 76).
